title: Time After Time, after Rod Stewart

details.title: Time After Time
details.lead: Rod Stewart's sung line, played straight on the trumpet. In his key, E, an octave up it would reach A♭5, so it is in E♭, a half step lower: concert C4 to G5 (written D4 to A5).
